_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The Spirit swept over the face of the waters.
And God said: let there be light.
John baptized in the wilderness with water.
But One came mightier, with the Holy Spirit.
The heavens tore open; the dove came down.
You are my Son, my Beloved.
Come to the water; come and worship.
Claim us again, O God. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: At the beginning, the Spirit hovered over the deep waters, and God spoke light into the dark.
We come to the water; claim us, O God.
Down at the Jordan the crowds waded in, and Jesus came too, down into the same river with us.
We come to the water; claim us, O God.
The heavens were torn open, the Spirit came down like a dove, and a voice named him Beloved.
We come to the water; claim us, O God.
That same voice still speaks over this water and over you. Come and remember whose you are.
We come to the water; claim us, O God. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The Spirit swept over the waters at the dawn.
We come to the water; claim us, O God.
Jesus steps down into the Jordan with us.
We come to the water; claim us, O God.
The heavens tear, the dove descends, the voice names him Beloved.
We come to the water; claim us, O God.
Come, remember your baptism and worship.
We come to the water; claim us, O God. Amen.
